[factorio-headless-server](https://github.com/aphexnexus/factorio-headless-server) - A Helm chart for running factorio in kubernetes

## Acknowledgement

This is a fork that was built on the incredible work done by [SQLJames](https://github.com/SQLJames/factorio-server-charts). Thank you for everything you have put into this project already.

## Introduction

This chart deploys Factorio on a [Kubernetes](http://kubernetes.io) cluster using the [Helm](https://helm.sh) package manager.

## Background

I was looking to build out my own k8s lab and wanted to use Factorio as the driving source. For my initial deployment I found [SQLJames](https://github.com/SQLJames/factorio-server-charts) repo but there were some extra pieces I wanted to add to it. Right now, the project is not seeing a lot of activity, so I decided to fork it and move forward with my own changes.

## Releases

Releases are published using the official helm release action in github.
https://github.com/helm/chart-releaser-action
